description: Nine fixed offsets and inversions of one input, or nine constant voltages when nothing is patched

params.text: Alt mode: recalculates every sample rather than every 10ms

inputs.text: The voltage the nine outputs are built from; with nothing patched it counts as 0V

outputs.text: The input passed through unchanged, which is 0V when nothing is patched
The input with its sign flipped, so a rising voltage falls
The input subtracted from 10V, which turns a 0-10V signal upside down while keeping it between 0V and 10V

notes: every output carries the same number of channels as the input, and one channel when the input is empty.
